g.text: Complete fixed-geometry cDFT comparison: undoped vs Al16

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #404040

g.text: N-1 removes one electron (hole localization); N+1 adds one electron. Values are localization penalties relative to each unconstrained state, not OER step free energies. Models are historical accepted undoped Co32 and

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #404040

g.text: chemically valid Al16 Co40; local sites are not identical, so use differences as mechanistic trends rather than formal oxidation states.
